title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Points — Advance Card Repayment Share
content:
The plan of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account adds points to the card repayment share of the linked Pocketwire Advance line. When the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, 10 points are added to the share; when it is on Pocketwire Plus, 5 points are added; on any other plan nothing is added to the share. A point is one percentage point of the share. The plan is the one the personal account's record shows.

| Personal account plan | Points added |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Summit | 10 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 10 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 10 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 5 |
| Pocketwire Core | Nothing |
| Pocketwire Lite | Nothing |

Illustration (hypothetical): a customer on Pocketwire Plus adds 5 points; a customer on Pocketwire Prime adds 10; a customer on Pocketwire Core adds none.
